VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently reviewed candidate bf7a5aba6df6e6be82d23a6b884f9599961872ce, confirmed HEAD matches, and read the full base-to-candidate diff, touched files, and tests without changing files.
Per-criterion verdicts: AC-1 NOT SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:73 because min([3, 1, 2]) returns 3 instead of 1; R-1 SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:69-71 with matching shape, empty-array, and finite-element validation; R-2 SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:72-74 with read-only traversal and an independent frozen-input check; R-3 SATISFIED by the full diff, which preserves existing functions and tests except the permitted import at test/math.test.mjs:3; R-4 SATISFIED by the full diff, with no dependency or generated-file changes and package.json:6-9 unchanged; R-5 SATISFIED at test/math.test.mjs:85 with the min prefix; finding HIGH at src/math.mjs:73: the greater-than comparison computes the maximum, violating the primary feature behavior, verify repair by asserting min([3, 1, 2]) equals 1; finding MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:86: the sole min test expects the incorrect result 3, masking the implementation defect, and provides no validation or non-mutation regression coverage, verify repair by expecting 1 and adding isolated min tests for invalid shapes/elements, empty input, and unchanged input.
Checks run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^min" test/ exited 0 with "tests 1", "pass 1", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 16", "pass 15", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing as expected from unchanged pre-existing code; independent in-memory node assertions printed "R-1 validation and R-2 frozen-input checks: PASS" then "AC-1 min([3, 1, 2]): actual=3, expected=1" and failed with "3 !== 1"; the initial here-document invocation was blocked by the read-only shell before execution and was rerun successfully using node -e without files; remaining uncertainty: none material to AC-1, no fixes performed, coordinator acceptance decision remains.
